name: search-paginate-cursor-resumes
$comment: ENH-030 continuation of search-paginate-first-page: the "$prev" sentinel runs page one, then resumes with its nextCursor. Page two must start strictly AFTER page one's last row (no boundary duplicate) and, being a short page (1 of 2), carry no nextCursor — so the two cases together pin non-overlapping, correctly ordered pages whose concatenation is the full ranked result. Same ranking derivation as the first-page case.
